import pytest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from src.punch_validation.models import PunchEvent, ValidationResult
from src.punch_validation.service import validate_punch

def test_valid_punch():
    # Punch exactly at office location during allowed hours (12:00 local => 06:30 UTC)
    event = PunchEvent(
        employee_id="emp123",
        timestamp=datetime(2023, 1, 1, 6, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        lat=12.9716,
        lng=77.5946,
    )
    result: ValidationResult = validate_punch(event)
    assert result.valid is True
    assert result.reason is None

import pytest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from src.punch_validation.models import PunchEvent, ValidationResult
from src.punch_validation.service import validate_punch

def test_punch_outside_radius():
    # Location ~1.1 km north of office (lat increased by ~0.01 degrees)
    event = PunchEvent(
        employee_id="emp124",
        timestamp=datetime(2023, 1, 1, 9, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),  # 14:30 local, within hours
        lat=12.9816,
        lng=77.5946,
    )
    result: ValidationResult = validate_punch(event)
    assert result.valid is False
    assert result.reason is not None
    assert "exceeds allowed" in result.reason

import pytest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from src.punch_validation.models import PunchEvent, ValidationResult
from src.punch_validation.service import validate_punch

def test_punch_outside_hours():
    # Punch within radius but at 23:30 local time (18:00 UTC) which is outside allowed window
    event = PunchEvent(
        employee_id="emp125",
        timestamp=datetime(2023, 1, 1, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),  # 23:30 local
        lat=12.9716,
        lng=77.5946,
    )
    result: ValidationResult = validate_punch(event)
    assert result.valid is False
    assert result.reason is not None
    assert "outside allowed window" in result.reason

import pytest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pydantic import ValidationError
from src.punch_validation.models import PunchEvent

def test_strict_input_validation():
    # employee_id must be a string; passing an int should raise ValidationError due to strict mode
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        PunchEvent(
            employee_id=12345,
            timestamp=datetime(2023, 1, 1, 6, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
            lat=12.9716,
            lng=77.5946,
        )
